headline: PARP10は、RRMが環状に連なって凝縮する
subhead: RRM1–3が頭尾でつながる開いた環を捉え、変異で静電的な接点を確かめた

summary.question: 相分離が酵素の活性をどう左右するのかは、まだよく分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: 精製PARP10をクライオ電顕で調べ、マップにAlphaFoldモデルをはめて、変異体を細胞で試した。
summary.result: 開いた環や9量体の閉じた環が見え、RRM1のR34–R36とRRM3のE190・E194・E196が接するモデルが得られた。
summary.learned: RRM1とRRM3の頭尾の静電的な接触が、PARP10の集合と凝縮に必要だと考えられる。
summary.open: アルギニン領域以外のドメイン間の相互作用は、今後の検討課題とされている。

question.quote: Despite growing interest, the extent to which phase separation regulates enzymatic activity and the functional consequences of elevated activity within condensates remain poorly understood.

approach.quote: We further examined the self-association behavior of recombinant PARP10 using single-particle cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM)
We thus fitted the predicted models of the head-to-tail dimer of RRM1-3 into our cryo-EM density

result.quote: A closed ring composed of nine protomers was observed, exhibiting an internal angle of ~140°.
At this interface, residues R34, R35, and R36 of RRM1 are positioned to interact with a negatively charged patch on RRM3

learned.quote: All mutations abolished condensate formation, phenocopying RRM deletion
Cryo-EM structural analysis combined with mutagenesis experiments demonstrates that an arginine-rich tract is essential for PARP10 oligomerization and phase separation in cells.

open.quote: Further investigations will elucidate the precise inter-domain interactions, in addition to the arginine tract identified here, that govern PARP10 oligomerization.

highlights.text: 環はRRM1と隣のRRM3が頭尾でつながってできる。電荷を保つR→K変異では凝縮が残り、電荷を消す・反転させる変異では凝縮が起きなかった。

evidence.quote: Ring assembly occurs through a head-to-tail interaction between RRM1 of one protomer and RRM3 of the adjacent protomer.
In contrast, a 3 RK mutant, which preserves the positive charge, retained the ability to form condensates

highlights.text: マップで見えたのはN末端のRRM1–3だけで、触媒ドメインなどは柔軟なため見えなかった。六量体のモデルは、AlphaFoldの予測をマップにはめて作られている。

evidence.quote: Other regions of PARP10, including the catalytic domain, were not visible, likely due to intrinsic flexibility
Clear density was observed for four of the six subunits, while the remaining two were partially resolved

highlights.text: 凝縮体は酵素活性を高めてNAD+の消費を増やし、ウイルスの複製を抑えると著者は述べている。

evidence.quote: PARP10 condensates enhance enzymatic activity, resulting in increased NAD⁺ consumption that ultimately inhibits viral replication.

lab_notes.sample_prep: 0.45 mg/mLのPARP10に0.05% n-オクチル-β-D-グルコシドを加え、Quantifoilグリッドに載せて凍結
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios G4・300 kV・Falcon 4i。12,772ムービーを収集し、CryoSPARCで処理

evidence.quote: 0.45 mg/mL purified PARP10 was supplemented with 0.05% n-octyl-β-D-glucoside (Anatrace, O311) before being applied onto glow-discharged holey carbon grids
A total of 12,772 movies were collected on Titan Krios G4 Cryo-TEM (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operating at 300 kV

editor_notes: EMD-65291 は中分解能のマップ（本文に分解能の数値なし）で、モデルはAlphaFoldの予測をはめたもの。論文の中心は細胞・生化学の実験で、構造は補助的。PDB 登録はない。
